card.name: Which/that after a repeated noun
card.fires_on: The relative words "which" or "that" right after a noun that sums up the preceding clause, often after a comma or dash. The noun is repeated or restated, as in "a condemnation which" or "a dose that".

modes.label: Appositive noun + which
modes.description: "Which" opens a relative clause after a noun that restates the previous idea.
modes.example: a condemnation<< which>> was confirmed in 1215

modes.label: Appositive noun + that
modes.description: "That" opens a relative clause after a noun that restates the previous point.
modes.example: a dose<< that>> may be associated with an increased risk of

card.writes: It adds little clear output; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the pattern.
card.plain: It fires on "which" or "that" when they start a comment about the noun just named, which sums up what came before.
